name: claude-viz
description: Visualize and analyze your Claude CLI sessions

installation.preInstall:
⚠️  This plugin requires claude-cli-viz to be installed first.

Install with: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thisiskorea/claude-cli-visualization/main/install.sh | bash

steps.name: Verify claude-cli-viz installation
steps.command: command -v claude-viz || (echo 'Installing claude-cli-viz...' && npm install -g claude-cli-viz)

installation.postInstall:
✅ Claude Visualization plugin installed!

Quick Start:
  /viz-start    - Start daemon
  /viz-view     - Open viewer
  /viz-status   - Check status

Or ask Claude: 'Start my visualization daemon'
